> MyServices is still in development and pull requests are **not handled for now** (see the README). If you already opened one,
> it stays open until the project leaves this phase. Please discuss it first in an issue or a discussion.

## What does it change, and why?

## How was it checked?

- [ ] Tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and `npm test` in `front/`)
- [ ] No token, password or private address in the change (the safety guard checks this too)
- [ ] Texts in the repository are in English (the interface texts are French with an English translation)
